about: A voice nobody knows talks long enough for the app to ask who it is. The owner answers out loud, the new voice talks again, and the owner spells the name.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Okay, what are we doing about dinner tonight? I haven't even looked in the fridge yet.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: There's leftover curry from yesterday, and I think there's still some rice in the pantry.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: Sorry to jump in, but I picked up fresh bread and a bag of tomatoes on the way over, if that's any help.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: I can make a quick salad while the curry heats up. It only takes about ten minutes.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: Oh, sorry, that's Mateo. He's staying with us this week.

turns.speaker: Mateo
turns.text: Hi everyone. Thanks for having me, the spare room is lovely.

turns.speaker: Alex
turns.text: And his name's spelt M, A, T, E, O.

turns.speaker: Sam
turns.text: Nice to meet you. Grab a plate whenever you're ready.
